acceptance: Accept a fully derived regulated full-source identity and useful connected certificate in its stated regime, even if the original unregularized S inverse remains open. Do not call the regulator removable or claim a homogeneous gap without independent missing premises.

definitions.controls: Independent exact integration/commutator coefficient checks; genuine source scope from S1; complete connected-word counts and time-simplex factors; rejecting omission of residual, wrong sign, lost multiplicity and unjustified all-time series integration. A generic spectral control is not an actual SU2 residual lower bound.
definitions.domain: Prove bounded skew-adjoint L_Theta, bounded commutator identity on D(G_Lambda), domain preservation and exponential preservation. Do not assume arbitrary bounded A preserves D(G) to prove it.
definitions.exceptions: tau0/source0, positiveTheta cap, reversed time or commutator sign, zero physical reference rejected, exact retained resonant block, truncation versus full filter.
definitions.filter: For 0<Theta<=1/16, proposed L_Theta,Λ(A)=-(i/2) integral_{-Theta}^{Theta} sign(s)(1-|s|/Theta) exp(isG_Lambda) A exp(-isG_Lambda) ds. Define vectorwise strong integral or another justified topology, not a formal unbounded commutator series.
definitions.generator: G_Lambda=H0_Lambda+sum_{Z_b subset Lambda} D_b, D_b=Q_b phi_b Q_b, ||D_b||<=M=7|tau|. Do not replace G_Lambda by its interior restriction.
definitions.infinite_volume: Finite-volume full-source identities and volume-independent weighted bounds are primary. Any infinite-volume identification with R2 G must additionally prove the required strong-resolvent/unitary or direct form-limit step; otherwise state it unproved.
definitions.new_parameter: Theta is a dimensionless proof filter duration, energy resolution scale delta/Theta. It is neither an action deformation nor a measured clock. The small time cap is a declared sufficient proof regime, not an optimal physical boundary.
definitions.scales: Fixed a,E_star,alpha/E_star,hbar>0, delta=alpha/8; real |tau|<=5/1664. G and source are dimensionless. Evolution parameter s equals delta times physical real time divided by hbar.
definitions.source: Use S1 A_b^gen on each actual star, identity-extended to containing retained-star cuboid; all21 omitted faces and complete24-link factors. Let r_*=sup_b ||A_b^gen|| with S1 actual cubic bound.
definitions.spectral_question: Derive [L_Theta,G_Lambda] and its full residual; calculate its action on a Bohr frequency including frequency0. A ground gap does not justify deleting low/zero-frequency residuals.
definitions.support: Use actual ordered connected Dyson words of bounded interaction-picture D_b(s), which preserve star support under onsite H0 evolution. Keep repetitions, incoming crossings and root multiplicity. Weight is exactly2^{|Y|}; support size <=4+3n is insufficient without a full coefficient sum.

model: Exactly S1 homogeneous full-link initial diagonal and actual generated cubic source; no canonical or finite physical magnetic-model transfer.
next_loop: After S2 review replan T/U contracts; V/W remain unselected until six loops.

target: Construct a regulated identity-extended full-source inverse with an exact retained residual, graph-domain control and a positive volume-weight connected-support certificate. Determine the precise limitation of removing the regulator.
